item.title: Growing up in South Florida: A 1950s Waterfront Childhood
item.description: Travel back to a "Mayberry" Florida. Explore the 1950s childhood of a West Palm Beach native, from skiing past gators to solo sailing and flying in a Sea Bee.

item.title: Tautog Fishing Tips: How to Catch More Blackfish This Season
item.description: Master the "cult fishery" of blackfish with Capt. Jon Azato’s tautog fishing tips. Learn the rigs, baits, and technology used to land record-breaking 20lb togs.

item.title: Navy SEAL RHIB Review: Tactical Power Meets the Open Water
item.description: Experience the 4G turns and bulletproof Kevlar of the USMI 36 Navy SEAL RHIB. A rare look at the elite military craft now hitting the recreational market.

item.title: Upgrade Your Onboard Experience with Kicker Audio - Power & Motoryacht
item.description: The MSLC is Kicker Audio's new light controller, which addresses two of the most persistent challenges in marine electronics: unwanted audio interference and insufficient power management.

item.title: Waterfront: Unplanned Obsolescence - Power & Motoryacht
item.description: Is it worth fixing a vintage outboard? Discover why this 14-foot McKee Craft owner ditched a smoky 1996 two-stroke for a modern, reliable Yamaha four-stroke.

item.title: De Antonio D60 - Power & Motoryacht
item.description: In this De Antonio D60 review, we test the flagship’s quad V12 Mercury 600s. Discover how this "wolf in sheep’s clothing" hits 46 knots with a shallow 3-foot draft.

item.title: An Axopar with Teeth - Power & Motoryacht
item.description: Power & Motoryacht talks with Shearer to discuss the finer points of the 37-foot Axopar Sun Top and the many hats this particular boat is able to wear

item.title: Life Aboard: Beneath the Keel - Power & Motoryacht
item.description: Explore the "Graveyard of the Atlantic" with a veteran diver. Discover the haunting history of North Carolina's shipwrecks lying just beneath your boat's keel.

item.title: Voyage with Purpose - Power & Motoryacht
item.description: Step aboard the RV Robert Gray, a historic 1936 diesel-electric ship. Discover its journey from the Great Depression to a modern-day ocean research expedition.

item.title: Sinking of the Nadine: The True Story Behind the Movie
item.description: The real story of the Sinking of the Nadine is more intense than 'The Wolf of Wall Street.' Capt. Mark Elliott recounts the 1996 Mediterranean storm and rescue.
